data.narrative:
Freenome is a public-stage biotech & health company founded by Gabriel Otte. The peer universe comprises 6 same-sector comparables spanning similar valuation tiers, including 2 public names (Recursion Pharmaceuticals at $1.6B, Alto Neuroscience at $1.0B) and 4 late-stage private firms (Abridge at $5.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, New Limit at $3.1B). The full comp set spans $539M to $5.3B.

Peer-median triangulation is the applicable method here. Across the 6-company peer set, the median valuation is $2.4B, with a range of $539M–$5.3B. This method anchors the analysis directly to observed market valuations of similarly-positioned biotech companies. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied because Freenome's revenue is not disclosed; the sector median P/S of 5.5x across 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) lacks the necessary revenue input.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B–$2.7B (low to high), centered on the peer median of $2.4B. Freenome's current $1.1B valuation sits materially below this range. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peers—data not available in this file—and stage-specific risk adjustments that would warrant discount or premium relative to the median.
